script.source: if (ctx.host_name != null) { if (ctx.host_name == 'host1') { ctx.environment = 'prod'; } else if (ctx.host_name == 'host2') { ctx.environment = 'staging'; } else if (ctx.host_name == 'host3') { ctx.environment = 'dev'; } } if (ctx.service_status != null) { if (ctx.service_status == 'UP') { ctx.response_code = 1; } else if (ctx.service_status == 'DOWN') { ctx.response_code = 0; } }
